1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes
15	
16	## Folder Structure
17	
18	```
19	src/
20	├── pages/                          # Route pages
21	│   ├── Index.tsx                   # Main dashboard (sidebar + detail view)

100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224

Simplify AccountInfoCard, WalletDropdown, and admin BillingTab. 5 6 --- 7 8 ## Files Read 9 - `src/pages/Billing.tsx` — currently just renders AccountInfoCard + PaymentHistoryCard + UsageHistoryCard 10 - `src/components/settings/AccountInfoCard.tsx` — imports BuyCreditsDialog + SubscriptionDialog, shows topup credits 11 - `src/components/WalletDropdown.tsx` — shows Monthly/Top-up/Bonus breakdown, "Buy Credits" button 12 - `src/components/SubscriptionDialog.tsx` — full plan cards + FEATURE_COMPARISON table + cancel/downgrade logic 13 - `src/components/BuyCreditsDialog.tsx` — PAYG topup dialog (to be deleted) 14 - `src/components/admin/BillingTab.tsx` — imports WalletSettingsTab, has "Wallet Top-Up" tab 15 - `src/components/admin/WalletSettingsTab.tsx` — manages payg_per_resume_cost, topup_min_amount, topup_dodo_product_id (to be deleted) 16 - `src/hooks/usePlatformConfig.tsx` — includes payg_per_resume_cost, topup_min_amount, topup_dodo_product_id 17 18 --- 19 20 ## Step-by-Step Plan 21 22 ### Step 1: Delete 3 files 23 - `src/components/BuyCreditsDialog.tsx` — delete 24 - `src/components/admin/CreditPacksTab.tsx` — delete (confirmed exists) 25 - `src/components/admin/WalletSettingsTab.tsx` — delete 26 27 ### Step 2: Rebuild `src/pages/Billing.tsx` 28 Move ALL plan logic from SubscriptionDialog into Billing.tsx directly. Structure: 29 30 1. **Page header** — "Billing & Plan" title + subtitle 31 2. **Current plan summary card** — plan name badge, credits remaining (subscription_credits + bonus_credits only, no topup), renewal date, "Manage Subscription" cancel button (inline AlertDialog) 32 3. **Plan cards section** — 4 plan cards (Free, + DB plans) with Monthly/Annual toggle Switch. Upgrade triggers Dodo checkout (same `create-dodo-checkout` flow from SubscriptionDialog). "Free" plan replaces "Pay As You Go" label. 33 4. **Feature comparison table** — FEATURE_COMPARISON from SubscriptionDialog, full width (not capped at 320px dialog) 34 5. **Payment History** — PaymentHistoryCard 35 6. **Usage History** — UsageHistoryCard 36 37 Key logic to port from SubscriptionDialog: 38 - `useQuery` for plans from "plans" table 39 - `handleSubscribe` → `create-dodo-checkout` edge function 40 - `handleCancelSubscription` → `cancel-dodo-subscription` edge function 41 - `handleDowngradeToFree` (rename from handleDowngradeToPayg, update "free" label) 42 - `confirmAction` AlertDialog (inline) 43 - FEATURE_COMPARISON constant 44 - `hasActiveSubscription`, `subscriptionEndsAt`, `isExpired` derivations from profile 45 46 Credits display: subscription_credits + bonus_credits only (no topup_credits) 47 48 ### Step 3: Simplify `src/components/settings/AccountInfoCard.tsx` 49 Changes: 50 - Remove `import BuyCreditsDialog from "@/components/BuyCreditsDialog"` 51 - Remove `import SubscriptionDialog from "@/components/SubscriptionDialog"` 52 - Remove `import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"` (already there, keep — needed for navigate) 53 - Remove "Top-up" from CREDIT_TYPES array → keep only "Monthly" and "Bonus" 54 - Change "Pay As You Go" text → "Free" everywhere it appears 55 - Remove topCredits calculation and references 56 - Remove BuyCreditsDialog trigger button ("Top Up" button in Credits header row) 57 - Change SubscriptionDialog wrappers → `

1	# Plan: Rankora — ZIP Upload + Candidate Tags + Assignee
2	
3	## Feature 1: ZIP Upload in BulkUploadZone
4	
5	### What needs to change
6	- `package.json` — add `jszip` dependency (but the task says run `npm install jszip` first)
7	- `src/components/BulkUploadZone.tsx` — accept `.zip` files, extract resume files from ZIP using JSZip dynamic import, add extracted files to queue, toast "Extracted X resumes from ZIP", update UI text
8	
9	### Key implementation details
10	- ACCEPTED_TYPES must include `"application/zip"`, `"application/x-zip-compressed"` (browsers send different MIME types for ZIP)
11	- ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS must include `,.zip`
12	- In `addFiles()`, detect ZIP files and handle async extraction before adding to queue
13	- Need to convert `addFiles` to async, or handle ZIPs as a special async path before calling regular `addFiles`
14	- Pattern: for each ZIP, use `const JSZip = (await import('jszip')).default;`, load the file as ArrayBuffer, then iterate `zip.files`, filter by resume extension, generate File objects from blob, call regular file validation/add logic
15	- Toast: `toast.success(\`Extracted ${count} resumes from ZIP\`)`
16	- UI drop zone text: mention ZIP in the format list
17	
18	### Risk: JSZip creates `Blob` objects from zip entries — need to construct `new File([blob], name, {type})` with correct MIME types based on extension
19	
20	---
21	
22	## Feature 2: Candidate Tags
23	
24	### 2a. Migration
25	File: `supabase/migrations/20260409200000_candidate_tags_and_assignment.sql`
26	Content is exactly as specified in the task — no changes needed.
27	
28	### 2b. Hook: `src/hooks/useCandidateTags.tsx`
29	- Fetches all tags for a job_id via `(supabase as any).from('candidate_tags').select('*').eq('job_id', jobId)`
30	- Groups tags by resume_id for O(1) lookup: `Map<resumeId, CandidateTag[]>`
31	- `addTag(resumeId, jobId, tag, color)` mutation — inserts into candidate_tags, toast success
32	- `removeTag(tagId)` mutation — deletes by id, toast success
33	- React Query with queryKey `['candidate-tags', jobId]`
34	- Realtime subscription on `candidate_tags` filtered by `job_id=eq.${jobId}` → invalidate query on INSERT/DELETE/UPDATE
35	- Cleanup subscription on unmount
36	- Export: `CandidateTag` type, `useCandidateTags(jobId)` hook returning `{ tagsByResumeId, addTag, removeTag, isLoading }`
37	
38	### 2c. Component: `src/components/candidate/CandidateTagInput.tsx`
39	Props: `resumeId: string`, `jobId: string`, `tags: CandidateTag[]`, `onAdd: (tag, color) => void`, `onRemove: (tagId) => void`
40	
41	- Preset tags: `['Shortlisted', 'On Hold', 'Top Choice', 'Follow Up', 'Culture Fit']`
42	- Color palette: 6 hex colors (indigo, emerald, amber, rose, sky, violet)
43	- Displays existing tags as colored chips with X button
44	- Input with autocomplete dropdown showing presets + already-used tags in this job (from all tags)
45	- Enter/comma to confirm a tag
46	- Max ~10 tags per candidate
47	- No extra UI libraries — just shadcn Popover + Input
48	
49	### 2d. Component: `src/components/candidate/AssigneeSelector.tsx`
50	Props: `resumeId: string`, `teamMembers: TeamMember[]`, `currentAssigneeId?: string | null`, `onAssign: (userId: string | null) => void`
51	
52	- Select dropdown (shadcn Select) with team member names/initials
53	- Shows "Unassigned" as default option
54	- On change: calls `(supabase as any).from('resumes').update({ assigned_to: userId }).eq('id', resumeId)` then invalidate resumes query
55	- Shows small avatar/initials badge next to the selector when assigned
56	
57	### 2e. Integration points
58	
59	**CandidateDetailSheet.tsx**
60	- Import `useCandidateTags`, `CandidateTagInput`, `AssigneeSelector`
61	- Add `teamMembers?: TeamMember[]` to props
62	- In scrollable panels section (after StageTracker, before CandidateNotesPanel): add Tags section + Assignee section
63	- Call `useCandidateTags(jobId)` inside the component (already has jobId)
64	- For AssigneeSelector, need to call `useTeam()` inside or receive teamMembers from parent
65	
66	**CandidateRow.tsx**
67	- Import `CandidateTag` type
68	- Add props: `tags?: CandidateTag[]`, `assigneeName?: string | null`  
69	- After the candidate name/location in the cell, render small tag chips (max 3, then "+N more")
70	- After name: show assignee badge (small circle with initials) if assigned
71	
72	**KanbanBoard.tsx**
73	- `KanbanCandidate` interface needs `tags?: CandidateTag[]`, `assigneeName?: string | null`
74	- In `KanbanCard`: below email, render tag chips (max 2) and assignee badge
75	
76	**JobDetailView.tsx**
77	- Call `useCandidateTags(selectedJobId)` hook
78	- Pass `tagsByResumeId.get(r.resume_id) ?? []` as `tags` prop to `CandidateRow`
79	- Pass tags to `KanbanBoard` candidates mapping
